test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No Improvement'.**

I __will have travelled__ all over Europe last year.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****travelled****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The error lies incorrect usage of the 'future perfect tense' in place of 'simple past tense'.
 
• Let's take a look at the sentence, the word 'last year' expresses that the action started in past, finished in past and has no relation to the present.
 
• **Simple past tense:** It is used to describe an action which started in past, finished in past and has no relation to the present.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject+ the second form of the verb
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• He **visited **Goa in 2015.
 
 
 
• Thus, '**travelled**' will be used in place of **'will have travelled'.**

 

Correct sentence:__ *I** __travelled__ **all over Europe last year.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Future perfect tense: The future perfect is a verb tense used for actions that will be completed before some other point in the future.
 
• Structure:
 
 
• will have + [past participle].
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• Linda** will have left** before you get there.
